Controls & help

A / D move · W / S enter / leave · 1–9 then 0 skills · [ / ] change bars · Space activates airborne skills · G summons your companion / uses their signature · V switches Auto aim high / low arc

ABILITY DETAILS

Basic Arrow

A fast-reloading standard shot.

Rank 0 · Bar 1, key 1

How to arrange abilities

Drag an ability onto a slot. Occupied slots swap places. A reserve ability replaces the target, returning that ability to reserve. Drop outside the bar or press Escape to cancel.

Touch: drag the dotted handle on an ability card, or drag a filled slot. You can also tap an ability, then tap a slot. Keyboard: Tab to an ability and press Enter, then Tab to a slot and press Enter.

Hover over a bar tab while dragging to change bars. Reserve abilities stay owned but do not cool down.
